item.title: Llamatik 2.0: Kotlin Multiplatform AI SDK with Agent Framework
item.description:
Llamatik 2.0: Kotlin Multiplatform AI SDK with Agent Framework

Llamatik 2.0 is a major architectural release of the Kotlin Multiplatform AI SDK, extracting reusable business logic into a clean, UI-agnostic, publishable SDK. It introduces a full Agent Framework for building agentic AI applications in Kotlin.

🔍 Overview

  • Llamatik is a 2026 Kotlin Foundation Grant winner.
  • It provides a true on-device AI SDK for Kotlin Multiplatform (Android, iOS, Desktop, JVM, WASM).
  • The SDK includes LLM inference, Speech-to-Text, Image Generation, Agent Framework, and RAG — powered by llama.cpp, whisper.cpp, and stable-diffusion.cpp.
  • Run AI locally on Android, iOS, Desktop, and WASM — using a single Kotlin API.

🧩 How it works

  • The inference library is now published as com.llamatik:core.
  • All existing APIs — LlamaBridge, WhisperBridge, StableDiffusionBridge, MultimodalBridge — are unchanged.
  • Business logic has been extracted from the application layer into a new :sdk module with zero UI or Compose dependencies — making it directly publishable and usable in any Kotlin Multiplatform project.
  • A new Assistant class (com.llamatik.sdk.assistant) owns all inference orchestration — chat, RAG, image generation, VLM, STT, model download, and session persistence — in a single, injectable facade.

⚙️ Key details

  • A complete Kotlin DSL for building agentic AI applications: Agent { } DSL — declarative agent creation with name, system prompt, temperature, memory, and tools.
  • Memory options include ConversationMemory, SlidingWindowMemory(windowSize), PersistentMemory, and SummaryMemory.
  • Tool Support — built-in tools (Calculator, DateTime, UUID, Random) + custom tool registration.
  • Streaming — agent.stream() returns a Flow for token-by-token output.
  • Workflows — sequential Step execution with WorkflowContext, approval gates, and continueOnError().
  • Observable Events — agent.events: SharedFlow for turn lifecycle hooks.
  • A production-ready agentic runtime for host-app integration: AgentRuntime — LLM-backed planner + execution engine with permission → confirmation → action → audit pipeline.
  • Permission Management — PermissionManager, KnownPermissions, grant/deny/ask-every-time policies.
  • 9 Built-in Platform Tools — Calendar, Reminder, OpenApp, OpenUrl, Clipboard, Share, Notification, SearchContacts, OpenSettings.
  • Companion Profiles — Assistant, Professional, Friendly, Companion, Pet personas with configurable style and planning aggression.
  • Persistent Memory — AgentMemory (Settings-backed, tag + type search, 200 entries).
  • Audit Log — AgentAuditRepository (Settings-backed, 1000 entries cap).
  • Workflow Engine — AgentWorkflowEngine (Flow-based, conditional/retry, WorkflowRepository).

🚀 Availability

  • Llamatik 2.0 is a major architectural release that extracts all reusable business logic into a clean, UI-agnostic, publishable SDK — and adds a full Agent Framework for building agentic AI applications in Kotlin.

💡 Why it matters

  • Llamatik is a Kotlin Multiplatform AI SDK that covers the full stack — from low-level on-device inference to high-level agent orchestration.

#Kotlin #AI #AgentFramework #Multiplatform #Llamatik

item.title: Hermes AI agent introduces built-in learning loop and multi-platform deployment
item.description:
Hermes AI agent introduces built-in learning loop and multi-platform deployment

A new AI agent, Hermes, has been introduced with a built-in learning loop, multi-platform deployment options, and extensive customization capabilities.

🔍 Overview

Hermes is an AI agent that creates and improves skills from experience, retains knowledge across sessions, and builds a deepening model of the user over time. It can search its own past conversations and nudge itself to persist knowledge.

⚙️ Key details

  • Learning loop: Built-in mechanism to create skills from experience, improve them during use, and retain knowledge across sessions.
  • Deployment flexibility: Runs on a $5 VPS, GPU cluster, or serverless infrastructure with near-zero idle costs.
  • Cross-platform access: Operates on a cloud VM and can be interacted with via Telegram.
  • Model compatibility: Supports Nous Portal, OpenRouter, OpenAI, custom endpoints, and many others. Switch models with hermes model without code changes or lock-in.
  • Multi-platform messaging: Integrates with Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, and CLI via a single gateway process.
  • Open standard: Compatible with the agentskills.io open standard.
  • Automation: Built-in cron scheduler with delivery to any platform, enabling unattended daily reports, nightly backups, and weekly audits in natural language.
  • Subagents: Spawns isolated subagents for parallel workstreams.
  • Scripting: Write Python scripts that call tools via RPC, collapsing multi-step pipelines into zero-context-cost turns.
  • Terminal backends: Supports seven terminal backends: local, Docker, SSH, Singularity, Modal, Daytona, and Vercel Sandbox.
  • Serverless persistence: Daytona and Modal offer serverless persistence, hibernating the agent’s environment when idle and waking it on demand.

🚀 Availability

  • Native Windows support: Runs natively on Windows without WSL, including CLI, gateway, TUI, and tools.
  • WSL2 support: Works on WSL2 using the same one-liner as Linux/macOS.
  • Installation: The installer handles dependencies (uv, Python 3.11, Node.js, ripgrep, ffmpeg) and includes a portable Git Bash (MinGit) for Windows, isolated from system Git. If Git is already installed, the installer detects and uses it.
  • Antivirus note: Some antivirus software may flag uv.exe in the Hermes bin folder as a false positive. The file is Astral’s uv, a Rust Python package manager bundled with Hermes.
  • Termux support: On Termux, Hermes installs a curated .[termux] extra to avoid Android-incompatible voice dependencies.
  • Installation paths: Native Windows installs under %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes; WSL2 installs under ~/.hermes as on Linux.

#AIagents #Hermes #AIdeployment #multiplatform #learningloop #serverless

Source: NousResearch/hermes-agent
